caption:
Thanksgiving dinner for 10 now averages $58.63. 🦃
The Farm Bureau's 41st annual survey says that's up 6% from last year, and the first yearly rise since 2022.
The 16-lb turkey alone: $23.68, up from $21.50.
Still below the 2022 record of $64.05, but your receipt may not feel that way.
How big is your Thanksgiving crowd this year?
